description.zh: 声明事件发生时刻，即为流程触发时刻，一般为请求构造时刻，时间戳，单位：毫秒。
description.en: The time when the event occurs. This is when the flow is triggered and is typically the time when the request is created. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh: 入参，Key-Value格式，其Key需要与您在流程开始节点配置的入参策略相匹配。在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面单击触发器类型为手动的流程名称进入画布编排界面查看开始节点的变量名称。
description.en: The input parameters in a key-value format. The keys must match the input parameter policy configured in the start node of the flow. To view the variable names in the start node, go to the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder), click the name of the flow, and open the orchestration canvas.

description.zh: 声明事件被丢弃时刻，即为触发流程的过期时刻，若声明了该字段，发起请求后响应时间超过此时刻，流程触发将被取消，时间戳，单位：毫秒。
description.en: The time when the event expires. If you specify this parameter, the trigger is canceled if the request is not processed before this time. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh: 流程编码。在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面查看流程编码。
description.en: The code of the flow. View the flow code on the [Flow Editor](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder) page.

description.zh: 自定义外部系统流水号，用于关联外部业务系统流水，触发后您可以在流程中获取到此参数。
description.en: A custom serial number from an external system. Use this parameter to associate the trigger with an external business process. After the flow is triggered, you can retrieve this parameter from within the flow.

description.zh: 自定义事件唯一ID，用于触发幂等，请勿携带任何业务语义，触发后您可以在流程中获取到此参数。
description.en: A custom unique ID for the event, used to ensure idempotence. Do not include business semantics in the ID. After the flow is triggered, you can retrieve this parameter from within the flow.

title.zh: 触发已上线的流程版本

descriptions.zh:
- 您可调用此接口触发已上线且触发器类型为手动的流程版本，也可在[营销活动管理](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/MarketingActivityManagement)界面通过营销活动关联的触发器类型为手动的流程进行流程触发。

- 在调用此接口之前，请确保您创建的流程触发器类型为手动且状态为已上线。

- 若您创建的触发器类型为手动的流程没有状态为已上线的版本，可在[流程编辑器](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder)界面单击流程名称进入画布编排界面手动上线流程版本或通过[OnlineFlowVersion](~~2937203~~)接口上线流程版本。

- 触发已上线的流程后，若您的流程含有消息发送、函数调用等产生对应云产品费用的组件，请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解相关产品的收费方式和价格。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to trigger a published version of a flow that has a manual trigger. You can also trigger the flow from the [Marketing Campaign Management](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/MarketingActivityManagement) page if the flow is associated with a marketing campaign.

- Before you call this operation, make sure that the flow has a manual trigger and is published.

- If a flow with a manual trigger does not have a published version, you must publish it. In [Chat Flow](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChatFlowBuilder), you can click the flow name to open the canvas and publish the version. Alternatively, you can call the [OnlineFlowVersion](~~2937203~~) API to publish the version.

- If your flow contains components that incur costs, such as message sending or function invocations, make sure that you understand the billing methods and pricing for these products before you trigger the flow.
